turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: Well, I came in because... honestly, I feel like I'm just falling apart lately. Ever since they changed my hours at the warehouse and put in this whole new inventory system, it's just been too much. I've been missing my shifts, which isn't like me, and I haven't been going to my church commitments either. I find myself snapping at my family all the time. Some mornings, I just... I sit there in my work boots, staring at the wall, just wondering if I can even face going into that place anymore. It's really getting bad.
